long_description:
Ignite Your Flow – Monday Night Yoga in Thornton Park, Downtown Orlando

Location: Kaleidoscope Thornton Park, 712 E Washington St, Orlando, FL 32801

Begin your week with intention, movement, and community.

Rest and release every Monday at 7PM during a gentle and restorative all-levels yoga class in the heart of Thornton Park—held at the outdoors at Kaleidoscope Thornton Park, just steps from Downtown Orlando and Lake Eola. Beginner friendly yoga class! 

This is more than a yoga class. It’s a space to ground your nervous system, release tension, and reconnect with your strength—while building genuine community in Orlando. Truly the best yoga class near you for deep presence and connection! 

We discuss yoga beyond the physical practice, meditate, and find stillness in movement. Our flow is very intentional with an emphasis on breath awareness - a yoga class where you can truly be present. Our flow is a mix between Hatha and Vinyasa yoga with a bit of intuitive movement. After class enjoy a cup of complimentary herbal tea as you connect with like-minded souls and build community over empowering conversations!

What You’ll Experience:

All-levels flow—energizing, mindful, and accessible for beginners

A blend of movement, breathwork, and nervous system support to help you recenter and recharge

A welcoming environment where you can show up exactly as you are—no pressure, just presence

Post-class connection time to sip tea, chat, and nourish your sense of belonging (we call it “communi-tea” for a reason 💛)

Free street parking and a vibrant outdoor space full of positive energy

Self-Investment: 

$15 early bird (register before 5PM day of class)

$22 drop-in after 5 PM (pay in person via cash, Zelle, Venmo)

Invest in $60 for a 5 class pack if you plan to build a weekly practice (must be used within 45 days of purchase)

BONUS: Enjoy 10% off your bill at Kaleidoscope before or after class—make it a full evening of movement, community, and nourishment
